# Jubilees Chapter 44 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Blessing of Ephraim and Manasseh; the tribal blessings; burial charge

---

**44:1** In the first year of the fifth week of the forty-fifth jubilee, Joseph brought his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim to his father Jacob.

**44:2** Jacob saw the sons of Joseph and said: "Who are these?" Joseph said: "They are my sons whom God gave me here in Egypt." Jacob said: "Bring them to me so that I may bless them."

**44:3** Jacob blessed them, and he placed Ephraim before Manasseh and blessed Ephraim before Manasseh.

**44:4** When Joseph saw this he was displeased and said: "Not so, my father, for Manasseh is the firstborn; place your right hand on his head." But his father refused and said: "I know it, my son; I know it. He also will be great. But his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become a multitude of nations."

**44:5** Jacob blessed them that day and said: "By you shall Israel pronounce blessing, saying: 'May God make you like Ephraim and like Manasseh.'" And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

**44:6** Jacob called all his sons and said to them: "Gather around me so that I may tell you what will happen to you in the last days."

**44:7** Jacob blessed his sons one by one in the order of the tribes.

**44:8** He said to Reuben: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might and the first of my strength, foremost in dignity and foremost in power. Unstable as water, you shall not have preeminence, because you went up to your father's bed; then you defiled it — he went up to my couch."

**44:9** Of Simeon and Levi he said: "Simeon and Levi are brothers; their swords are weapons of violence. Let my soul not enter their council; let my honor not be joined to their assembly. For in their anger they killed men, and in their wantonness they hamstrung oxen. Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel."

**44:10** Of Judah he said: "Judah, your brothers shall praise you; your hand shall be on the neck of your enemies; your father's sons shall bow down before you. Judah is a lion's cub. The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs."

**44:11** Jacob blessed all his sons, each with his appropriate blessing, and commanded them: "Bury me in the cave of Machpelah in the field of Ephron the Hittite."

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus following LOGOS. The tribal blessings in vv.8-10 closely follow Genesis 49:3-10, and the scepter oracle (v.10) is the third appearance in Jubilees (also chs.31 and 38). The burial charge (v.11) is the patriarchal tradition from Genesis 49:30.*
